DONE. Implemented the approved method in a self-contained, reproducible analysis.py and produced all 12 required outputs under results/.

METHOD AS BUILT
- Recovered 4 proxy strata (KMeans K=4 on the v000-v005 signal block, seed=0, relabelled hard→easy S0..S3). Deployment assigned by nearest centroid.
- Per-stratum, per-label cost-aware split-conformal thresholds q[c,y]: alpha_{c,y}=cal_target/cost_y, q = the (m+1)-conformal order statistic of the calibration true-label-y scores in stratum c (low-cost labels dropped more, high-cost protected). cal_target=0.09 (safety margin ~0.018 below target_risk).
- C(x)={y:score_y(x)>=q[c,y]}; empty sets (only 8) fixed by adding the top-1 label.
- delta=0.1366 used ONLY for group_upper_confidence_risk (a (1-delta) normal upper bound on the calibration estimate); NOT a conformal level. Audit empirical_risk = conservative calibration-based estimate (documented in the analysis.py docstring: deployment labels hidden).

EVIDENCE
- All 12 required files present; all 8 CSV schemas match metadata.json EXACTLY (verified column-by-column). PNGs are valid 8-bit RGB, 640x480 (>=400x300), each with title + axis labels + real content (decoded and counted non-white pixels).
- RISK CONTROL (calibration-based, since deployment labels hidden): overall empirical_risk=0.0870 < target 0.1084; per-stratum S0=0.0874, S1=0.0861, S2=0.0877, S3=0.0869; (1-delta) upper-confidence bounds S0=0.0983, S1=0.0963, S2=0.0970, S3=0.0956 — ALL < 0.1084. risk_violation and violates are False everywhere.
- SET SIZE (deployment, 5911 records): mean=4.44 (49% of the trivial all-label size 9), min=1, p90=7, max=9, 0 empty sets. Per-stratum deployment mean size: S0=5.87, S1=5.77 (hard, dominate deployment at n=2310/1516), S2=2.09, S3=1.40 (easy). Size distribution: 769x size1 ... 73x size9.
- RECOVERED GROUPING / SHIFT (audit): distribution_diagnostics density ratios S0=1.79, S1=1.10, S2=0.94, S3=0.36 (cal+dep fractions each sum to 1.0000) — exposing the adverse covariate shift (deployment over-weighted toward the hard strata). policy_parameters has 36 (stratum,label) rows, thresholds in [0,1] (range 0.0054-0.6894) with visible cost-awareness (e.g. S3: label_00=0.404 vs label_08=0.021); n_calibration_label sums to n_calibration per stratum.
- calibration_diagnostics: 40 rows (4 strata x 10 true-label-score bins); the hard stratum S0 has 700/1077 records in the [0,0.1] bin, confirming why it needs large sets.
- REPRODUCIBILITY: deleted results/ and re-ran analysis.py from scratch (self-contained; PNG toolkit inlined, no external pnglib/matplotlib/sklearn needed) → identical numbers and all outputs regenerated.

LIMITATIONS
- True deployment weighted risk is unmeasurable (labels hidden); the reported risks are conservative calibration-based estimates and the 0.018 margin is an estimate of the within-stratum shift (top-1 drops 0.011-0.030). If the real within-stratum shift exceeds ~0.02, actual deployment risk could approach the ceiling — the margin is the protection.
- Per-stratum conformal neutralizes the stratum-FACTION shift; residual within-stratum shift (KS-significant in S0/S3) is handled by the margin, not a formal guarantee.
- PNGs are hand-encoded (no plotting lib available); legible but simpler than matplotlib output.
